title: Recording: London Town by Wings | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Wings continued recording the song ‘London Town’ on 21 March 1977.

Despite taping a number of takes, the band eventually decided that they could not improve the song, and that a recording from 14 February should remain the master version.
